subject: general
question: Which of the following are copper deposits fields in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Khetri and Kolihan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Khetri and Kolihan** are prominent copper mines located in the Jhunjhunu district of Rajasthan, India.
 
• Khetri Copper Complex (KCC) is operated by Hindustan Copper Limited (HCL).
 
• Khetri is known for its rich copper deposits, which are mined and processed for various industrial applications.
 
• The Kolihan mine is an underground copper mine adjacent to the Khetri mine and contributes significantly to India's copper production.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hindustan Copper Limited (HCL)**

 
 
• HCL is a public sector enterprise under the Ministry of Mines, Government of India.
 
• It is the only vertically integrated copper producer in India involved in a wide spectrum of activities ranging from mining to beneficiation, smelting, refining, and casting of refined copper metal.
 
 
 
• **Uses of Copper**
 
 
• Copper is a highly conductive metal used in electrical wiring, plumbing, and the manufacture of electronics and machinery.
 
• It is also used in the production of alloys such as bronze and brass.
 
 
 
• **Other Major Copper Mines in India**
 
 
• Malajkhand Copper Project in Madhya Pradesh, operated by HCL.
 
• Taloja Copper Project in Maharashtra.
 
 
 
• **Global Copper Production**
 
 
• Chile is the world's largest copper producer, followed by Peru, China, and the United States.
 
• Copper mining and production contribute significantly to the economies of these countries.
